_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "Gumroad's flat 10% transaction fee (plus processing fees) effectively penalizes growth. For a creator generating $50,000 annually, Gumroad claims over $5,000 in platform fees alone. In contrast, platforms like ThriveCart, which offer one-time payments, cap these costs, drastically increasing net revenue retention."
